div.div: مَبْهُوظٌ Oppressed by the weight of a load, and unable to bear it. (S.) [And hence,] (assumed tropical:) Any one having a thing required of him which he is unable to do, or which he cannot find. (TA.) And قِرْنٌ مَبْهُوظٌ (assumed tropical:) An opponent, or an adversary, overcome, or vanquished. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
